Subject: Post-demo: trust portal access + regulatory scope confirmation

Hi David — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our demo and the compliance items you asked us to confirm so your security team can complete the intake: 

- SOC 2 Type II: you asked for a redacted report and a bridge letter for the window between audits. We can provide a redacted PDF and a signed bridge letter.
- Trust portal: access for your security reviewers (temporary role-based link or S3 object access).
- Regulatory scope: confirm whether GDPR data residency restrictions or HIPAA BAA are required for your use case.
- Vendor questionnaire (DDQ): we can start the intake form now; please confirm preferred format (DocuSign/upload vs. shared link).

Next steps I propose: I will get the redacted SOC 2 and bridge letter to you by EOD Monday (Jul 19), provision a trust-portal reviewer invite, and kick off the DDQ with Mina (CC). If HealthAxis needs a HIPAA BAA, we’ll route to Contracts — please flag now if that’s necessary.

Call recording: demo_recording_07182027.mp4 (attachment stub).

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales

From: David Foster <david.foster@healthaxis.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: trust portal access + regulatory scope confirmation

Thanks Marcus — that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our security lead: 

1) We need a redacted SOC 2 Type II covering the latest 12-month window; redactions for critical customer data are fine.
2) A signed bridge letter dated for the current audit window would be great — our procurement team requires it for the contract review.
3) Trust portal: ideally we get a reviewer invite with read-only access and the ability to download artifacts. If S3 pre-signed objects are simpler short-term, that works too.
4) Regulatory: HealthAxis operates in the US and EU; GDPR is material — please confirm whether Redwood can attest to data residency controls or if we need additional tooling. HIPAA applies to this use case; can you confirm Redwood will sign a BAA?

I'll attach our intake packet to the thread (HealthAxis_DDQ.pdf) — feel free to assign sections to the right owner. Target timeline: bridge letter + SOC2 redaction by Jul 20 so procurement can start review next week.

-David
David Foster
Head of Security Operations
HealthAxis
